Error t value Pr(>|t|)    ## (Intercept)        35.8112    55.1166   0.650  0.52156    ## age                 3.2381     1.0088   3.210  0.00352 ** ## stateNebraska      65.4866    61.9834   1.057  0.30045    ## age:stateNebraska  -0.7177     1.1628  -0.617  0.54247    ## --- ## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1 ##  ## Residual standard error: 43.14 on 26 degrees of freedom ## Multiple R-squared:  0.5326, Adjusted R-squared:  0.4786  ## F-statistic: 9.875 on 3 and 26 DF,  p-value: 0.00016

title: Session 1 lab: Association between cholesterol and age
code: anova(fit) ## Analysis of Variance Table ##  ## Response: cholesterol ##           Df Sum Sq Mean Sq F value    Pr(>F)     ## age        1  48976   48976 26.3124 2.388e-05 *** ## state      1   5456    5456  2.9315   0.09877 .   ## age:state  1    709     709  0.3809   0.54247     ## Residuals 26  48395    1861                       ## --- ## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1

title: Session 1 lab: Association between cholesterol and age
Session 1 lab: Association between cholesterol and age
code: fit1 <- lm(cholesterol ~ state, data=chol) fit2 <- lm(cholesterol ~ state + age, data = chol) anova(fit1, fit2) ## Analysis of Variance Table ##  ## Model 1: cholesterol ~ state ## Model 2: cholesterol ~ state + age ##   Res.Df    RSS Df Sum of Sq      F    Pr(>F)     ## 1     28 102924                                   ## 2     27  49104  1     53820 29.593 9.361e-06 *** ## --- ## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1

what: Backwards selection to select the best prediction model
title: Session 1 lab: Association between cholesterol and age
text: AIC = Akaike’s Information Criterion
code: library(MASS) fit <- lm(cholesterol ~ age * state, data=chol) step <- stepAIC(fit, direction = "backward") ## Start:  AIC=229.58 ## cholesterol ~ age * state ##  ##             Df Sum of Sq   RSS    AIC ## - age:state  1    709.05 49104 228.01 ## <none>                   48395 229.58 ##  ## Step:  AIC=228.01 ## cholesterol ~ age + state ##  ##         Df Sum of Sq    RSS    AIC ## <none>                49104 228.01 ## - state  1      5456  54560 229.18 ## - age    1     53820 102924 248.22
